section.title: Answers to common questions
section.description: Short, direct answers to the things people ask us most often.

what-is-gdg.question: What is GDG UofK?
what-is-gdg.answer: Google Developer Group University of Khartoum is a community of developers, designers, and tech enthusiasts who learn, share, and build together. We're part of the global Google Developer Groups network — run by students, for students.

need-to-be-student.question: Do I need to be a student to join?
need-to-be-student.answer: No. GDG is open to everyone, regardless of background or profession. While our community is based at the University of Khartoum, we welcome learners, developers, and enthusiasts from any university or career path.

how-to-join.question: How can I join GDG UofK?
how-to-join.answer: You can join by attending our events, following our social media channels, and registering through our official website. Membership is free and there are no prerequisites — just bring your curiosity.

time-commitment.question: How much time do I need to commit?
time-commitment.answer: There's no minimum commitment. You can attend events as your schedule allows — whether it's a single workshop or a full study jam series. Everything we offer is designed to fit around your studies.

events-free.question: Are GDG events free?
events-free.answer: Yes, all GDG events are free and open to anyone interested in technology. Our community workshops, talks, and study jams are always free — you'll never be asked to pay to attend.

activities.question: What kind of activities does GDG organize?
activities.answer: We organize workshops, hackathons, study jams, speaker sessions, and networking events focused on Google technologies and beyond — covering topics from Android and Flutter to AI, web development, and cloud.
